info.title: Double Tree by Hilton
info.description: DoubleTree by Hilton Gurugram Baani Square (Asset, 100% owned by Baani Group) at Baani Square is located near the prime corporate, commercial and residential districts in Gurugram, Delhi NCR. This grand hotel is just a 10-minute drive from DLF Cyber City, which is a central business and entertainment hub. The guest rooms & suites at the hotel offer brilliant facilities that include complimentary high-speed internet access and, a hospitality centre with a mini refrigerator & coffee/tea maker. The lush lawns and the courtyard surrounding the hotel are perfectly suited for business events, social gatherings, private receptions and weddings.

info.title: Hilton - Baani City Centre
info.description: Baani City Center is strategically located at Sector 63, Gurugram. The project offers High-Street Retail, a Food Court and service Apartments. Baani City Center offers you the opportunity to enjoy an international lifestyle at your doorstep. With its modern and trendy European appeal, Baani City Center brings you a world of choices in premium retail, living and hospitality. The Retail space offered is designed to cater to both national and international brands & the food court has ample space for assorted food outlets.Baani City Center is situated amidst the fastest-growing Golf Course Zone in Gurugram and witnesses maximum footfall.

info.title: The Corporate One
info.description: Baani Corporate One is a new-generation project, which has all modern facilities and amenities. Not just strategic location, Jasola has promising infrastructure as compared to other commercial zones in South Delhi with improving connectivity. There are multiple property options and types available for investment in Baani Corporate One, which caters to various budget ranges. This project has all major facilities to offer to cater to all kinds of working professionals.  Additionally, there are other conveniences available here such as a  Cafeteria, Food Court, 24/7 Power Backup, etc.

info.title: Baani Square
info.description: Baani Square is located in sector 50. This project is a High Street Retail destination. Baani Square is spread across 3 acres of landscape and set amidst lush greenery. The project is wonderfully planned with stylish cafes, multi-cuisine restaurants, recreational facilities and more. With its corner location and modern architectural design, Baani Square offers high visibility and a refreshing experience to shoppers. This contemporary development made out of concrete, stone, steel and glass stands on the 90M wide main Nirvana road next to a five-star hotel.

info.title: The Statement
info.description: A modern glass finished office building, Baani The Statement is located on Golf Course Road, Sector 43, Gurugram. The office building is located under 0.5 Kilometer away from the Sector 42-43 Rapid Metro Station and closer to the very prime location that makes people's daily trips so easy and stress-free. Built for any type of business, it provides a professional working environment alongside comfort.

info.title: Address One
info.description: Baani The Address One is a high-end commercial complex set on the Golf Course Road in Sector 56, Gurgaon. The structure has a design such that it offers it to be a workplace of the modern and most effective type, which is also the reason it is at the top of the list of every company that needs a prestigious address in Gurgaon. Baani The Address is an ideal choice for organizations that require a super high-end and modern commercial space in Gurgaon owing to its strategic location as it is conveniently placed near all the key business hubs, retail outlets, and dining options.
